our_interpretation: The ordinary contextual reading concerns Sora's usefulness for making directed, consistent movie scenes, rather than whether it can produce any usable footage.
Ordinary editing and color grading do not establish failure. Repeatedly changing the intended scene or repairing unwanted content is relevant evidence of a workflow limitation.
The speaker supplies no reporting period. I use the latest completed month and the elapsed publication month, April 1 through May 13, 2024, for the ongoing preview workflow.
The phrase about making a movie specifies the use case; it is not a conditional forecast.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporary production records establish that Sora could not reliably deliver intended, consistent movie scenes without substantial corrective work or changes to the intended scenes.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A documented professional movie production demonstrates that the contemporary Sora workflow reliably delivered intended, consistent scenes with ordinary production work.
